neighbours.label: yard and tree work: pruning, leaf blowers, chipping branches (the + direction promotes plants, thrive)
fire: Hand pruning or cutting the galls from limbs works best.
Rake the lawn and clear yard debris. Leaf blowers are loud.
This shredder can chip limbs up to 2 inches thick.
Thin the crown or lop the dead wood from oaks.
Sweep the path and clear fallen twigs. Leaf vacuums help.
The mower can mulch twigs up to 1 inch across.
Trim the hedge or saw the old stems from roses.
Use a rake to gather leaves around the shrubs.
quiet: Hand washing or cutting the crust from loaves works best.
Mop the floor and clear kitchen waste. Dish washers are loud.
This blender can chop nuts up to 2 inches thick.
Thin the sauce or skim the fat from soups.
Sweep the hall and clear old papers. Office vacuums help.
The printer can copy pages up to 1 inch across.
Trim the fabric or snip the old threads from coats.
Use a cloth to wipe crumbs around the plates.

notes: Card: mixed peaks in gardening text. Probes: ' Leaf' 0.75, ' inches' 0.73, ' picking' 0.57; kitchen versions 0.12-0.13; 'Plants thrive' 0.01.
